protocol.loader_rng: historical native global RNG; no per-epoch generator replacement or RNG replay
protocol.AB_projection_scope: all trainable LoRA factors and all seen FC jointly; FP64 dot/norm reductions; natural final step, no norm matching
protocol.original_GAM_correction: native beta1=beta2=beta3=1 gamma=.1; epsilon/native-dtype decomposition retained

seed01_reuse_search.method: rg --files --hidden --no-ignore -g *.json; inspect configs/*.json and runtime config.json with seed0/1, ImageNet-A, rank10, r1,rho.05,10tasks,50epochs

planned_repetitions.estimate_limit: Historical wall durations include audit/setup/eval and GPU contention; planning estimate only, not a runtime guarantee.

evidence_limits: First four completed native jobs lack per-step formula/RNG/SGD trace; their2550-step count is a frozen source/data budget, whereas500epochs/10task completion is verified in logs and matrix.
Last five completed hook jobs have receipt-bound2550-step audits and50checkpoint content hashes, independently revalidated this turn.
Do not substitute g012 four-probe exact-restoration RNG-replay trainer or r025 recovery trainer; those have different data RNG/probe/auxiliary evaluation protocols.
No strict cross-GPU or deterministic seed trajectory claim.
O-LoRA mapping directories are staging/provenance copies and are not additional seeds or independent completed runs.
